definitions.gloss: duty, being on duty, person on duty
definitions.explanation: A scheduled turn to perform a task or responsibility, or the person assigned to that duty.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧{当番|とうばん}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Today is my turn for cleaning duty.

examples.japanese: {当番|とうばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交代|こうたい}→交替：04146_koutai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{日直|にっちょく}→日直：14927_nicchoku⟧{当番|とうばん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{黒板|こくばん}→黒板：02756_kokuban⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消|け}す→消す：00528_kesu⟧。
examples.english: The person on daily duty erases the blackboard.

notes:
{当番|とうばん} describes rotating duties or the person assigned to them.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {当番|とうばん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to be on duty
- ⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧{当番|とうばん}: cleaning duty
- ⟦{給食|きゅうしょく}→給食：13800_kyuushoku⟧{当番|とうばん}: school lunch duty
- {当番|とうばん}⟦{制|せい}→制：noentry⟧: duty rotation system
- {当番|とうばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧: to assign duty
